programme.title: Finding Nemo

programme.title: Finding Dory

programme.title: The Pacifier
programme.desc: Shane Wolfe, a Navy SEAL, fails to rescue a government scientist, Howard Plummer, from Serbian rebels. Later, he is assigned to protect Plummer's children from his enemies.

programme.title: Breaking Infinity
programme.desc: Time-jumping scientist Liam, guided by a mysterious elder, travels to a future where he sees global destruction he might have caused.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Shan, a beautiful mermaid, is sent on a mission to kill Liu Xuan, a business tycoon. However, complications arise when they develop feelings for each other.

programme.title: Ferdinand
programme.desc: A wisecracking goat and three hedgehogs try to help a giant but gentle bull escape from his captors.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Voyage of the Dawn Treader
programme.desc: Siblings Edmund and Lucy return to the fantasy realm of Narnia with their cousin, Eustace. Soon, the trio embarks on a voyage across the seas with an old friend to rescue seven lords.

programme.title: Firefighters
programme.desc: Based on the Hongje-dong fire accident in 2001, the movie depicts the harsh conditions that firefighters face every day as if it were their last mission to save lives and survive.

programme.title: Revolver
programme.desc: Su-young gets entangled in corruption and takes the blame for a reward. After her release, she finds Andy who promised her the reward but faces a bigger force behind him.

programme.title: My Puppy
programme.desc: A groom-to-be sets off with his friend to finding a new owner for his puppy.

programme.title: Cobweb
programme.desc: Director Kim has completed filming Cobweb, but he decided to re-shoot the ending. With chaos and people don't understand the new ending, will Kim be able to complete his masterpiece?

programme.title: The Ultimate Duo
programme.desc: Jae-hyuk teams up with rookie detective Joong-ho. They arrest a thief and discover he may be a culprit of a closed case. They reopen the case yet the investigation runs into obstacles...

programme.title: Nocturnal
programme.desc: After his brother Seok-tae returns as a bloody corpse, Min-tae discovers the death of his brother was foretold in a novel, and Seok-tae's wife had a suspicious call with the novelist...

programme.title: The Woman in the White Car
